cards.text: We're in the Garden of Eden with the man and his wife (Genesis 2:15, 25). Now meet the serpent, more crafty than any beast of the field the LORD God had made. He asks the woman, “Did God really say, ‘You must not eat from any tree in the garden?’”

cards.question: The crafty serpent asks the woman about the trees. True or false: the woman tells him God said they must not eat from any tree in the garden.

cards.text: The woman sets him straight: they may eat the fruit of the trees. Asking about ANY tree is like hearing one parking spot is reserved and going, “So we can't park ANYWHERE?”
But about the tree in the middle of the garden, she says God told them not to eat of it or even touch it.

cards.question: About the tree in the middle of the garden, what does the woman say God said would happen if they eat of it?
Now the crafty serpent answers the woman about dying. What does he tell her?

answers.text: You will die if you touch it

cards.text: Then the serpent keeps going. He says God knows that in the day they eat of it, their eyes will be opened.

cards.question: The serpent says that if they eat from the tree, they will be like ___, knowing good and evil.

cards.text: Now the woman sees the tree is good for food, pleasing to the eyes, and desirable for obtaining wisdom. Three for three, friend, and that tree's getting better reviews than my whole bakery.

cards.question: The woman sees the tree is good for food, pleasing to the eyes and desirable for obtaining wisdom. What does she do next?

answers.text: She takes the fruit and eats it
She walks away from the tree
She asks the serpent to leave

cards.question: The woman gives some of the fruit to her husband. True or false: he was off in another part of the garden when this happened.

cards.text: He was right there with her, and he ate it too. Then the eyes of both of them are opened, and they know that they are naked.

cards.question: The man and his wife now know that they are naked. What do they make for themselves?

cards.text: Then the man and his wife hear the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the breeze of the day.

cards.question: The man and his wife hear the LORD God in the garden. True or false: they hide themselves among the trees of the garden.

cards.text: But the LORD God calls out to the man, “Where are you?”

cards.question: The man answers the LORD God from his hiding spot. Why does he say he hid?

answers.text: He was afraid because he was naked
He was ashamed of what the serpent said
He was busy working in the garden

cards.text: The LORD God asks him, “Who told you that you were naked?” Then He asks if the man has eaten from the tree He commanded him not to eat from.

cards.question: The LORD God has asked the man about the tree. True or false: the man says the serpent gave him the fruit.

cards.text: He says, “The woman whom You gave me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.” Friend, that's like showing up late to work and saying, “Don't look at me, my carpool was driving.”

cards.question: The LORD God asks the woman, “What is this you have done?” She answers that the ___ deceived her, and she ate.

cards.text: So the LORD God speaks to the serpent: “Because you have done this, cursed are you above all livestock and every beast of the field!” On his belly he'll go, and dust he'll eat, all the days of his life.

cards.question: The LORD God tells the serpent He will put enmity between the serpent and the woman, and between the serpent's seed and her seed. Who crushes whose head?

answers.text: Her seed crushes the serpent's head
The serpent crushes her seed's head
The serpent's seed crushes her head

cards.text: And the serpent will strike his heel. Then to the woman, the LORD God says He will sharply increase her pain in childbirth.

cards.question: True or false: the LORD God also tells the woman her desire will be for her husband, and he will rule over her.

cards.text: Then He turns to the man, Adam. Because Adam listened to the voice of his wife and ate from the tree, cursed is the ground because of him.

cards.question: Now the ground is cursed because of Adam. How will Adam eat of it all the days of his life?

cards.text: The ground will yield thorns and thistles, and by the sweat of his brow he'll eat his bread. Working the ground just got switched to HARD MODE.

cards.question: The LORD God says Adam will return to the ground, because out of it he was taken. What does He say Adam is?

cards.text: After all of that, Adam names his wife Eve.

cards.question: Why does Adam name his wife Eve?

answers.text: She would be the mother of all the living
She was the first one to see the tree
She would help him work the ground

cards.question: Adam and his wife are still wearing the coverings they made for themselves. True or false: the LORD God makes clothes for them Himself.

cards.text: He makes garments of skin, and He clothes them. Fig leaves, you are officially RETIRED.
Then the LORD God says, “Behold, the man has become like one of Us, knowing good and evil.” And He speaks of the man reaching out his hand to take from another tree too, and eat, and live forever.

cards.question: The LORD God has spoken of the man taking from another tree and living forever. True or false: He lets the man stay in the Garden of Eden.

cards.text: So the LORD God banishes him from the Garden of Eden, to work the ground he was taken from.

cards.question: The LORD God drives the man out. What does He station on the east side of the Garden of Eden?

answers.text: Cherubim and a whirling sword of flame
A pillar of fire and cloud

cards.question: The cherubim and the whirling sword of flame guard the way to the tree of ___.
